description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact on both staff development and patient safety.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing staff education programs to ensure clinical competency and adherence to best practices. Concurrently, you will lead infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of residents and staff through surveillance, policy development, and education.

If you are a proactive and experienced nurse with a passion for education and infection control, we encourage you to apply promptly to join a supportive and dynamic team.
requirements: Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a fantastic opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, providing essential therapy services on a flexible, as-needed basis.

As a PRN Speech Language Pathologist, you will be responsible for assessing, diagnosing, and treating individuals with communication and swallowing disorders. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain function and improve their quality of life.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus for qualified candidates. Join a supportive environment where your expertise is valued and you can truly make a difference.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows you to provide essential therapeutic services, helping patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life. You will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans and contributing to a supportive patient care environment.This flexible PRN role is ideal for a skilled PTA looking to make a significant impact on patient recovery while managing their own schedule. Join a team committed to excellence in rehabilitation and patient-centered care.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Prior experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience.
